On Tue, Apr 30, 2024 at 3:02 PM Cara Thanassi <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Just weighing in here. From the LAC side of the house, we plan to review the report again, identify LAC
specific issues, and have a follow up conversation with them regarding any concrete actions they have
taken as a result of the report or plan to take. From the report, I would be reluctant to recommend
organizations participate in the TPP.
However, since this is a global issue, having a common agenda on this driven by the DRG Bureau in
collaboration with the regional bureaus would be useful and likely more effective.
Thanks,
Cara
On Tue, Apr 30, 2024 at 2:55 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
No. We have not.
